exams.name: North Dakota Laws and Rules Examination
exams.notes: Must be passed within one year of making application.
exams.quote: The applicant has passed, within one year of making application, a written examination on the laws and rules governing the practice of dentistry in this state.

interval_years.quote: Licenses expire on December thirty-first of every odd-numbered year.

required.quote: Licenses may be renewed by December thirty-first of the odd-numbered year by submitting a renewal application, a renewal fee established by the board by rule, and proof of completion of the continuing education requirements established by the board by rule

available.quote: The board may issue a license and certificate of registration to practice dentistry in this state to an applicant who meets the following requirements: The applicant, for at least five years immediately preceding application, has been licensed in good standing and has been actively practicing dentistry in another jurisdiction where the requirements are at least substantially equivalent to those of this state

requirements.value: Applicant must have been licensed in good standing and actively practicing dentistry in another jurisdiction with substantially equivalent requirements for at least five years immediately preceding application; must deliver certificates of good standing from all jurisdictions; must pass the ND laws and rules examination; must pay the fee; and grounds for denial must not exist.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in dishonorable, unprofessional, or immoral conduct.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaged in dishonorable, unprofessional, or immoral conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of an offense with a direct bearing on ability to serve the public as a dentist, or not sufficiently rehabilitated.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been convicted of an offense determined by the board to have a direct bearing upon the individual's ability to serve the public as a dentist, or the board determines, following conviction for any offense, that the individual is not sufficiently rehabilitated under section 12.1-33-02.1.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adjudged mentally ill and not judicially restored, or having a physical or mental disability materially affecting ability to practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been adjudged mentally ill and not judicially restored by the regularly constituted authorities or have a physical or mental disability materially affecting the ability to carry out the duties within the scope of practice in a competent manner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Used alcohol or drugs to such a degree as to interfere with the ability to safely perform duties.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Used alcohol or drugs to such a degree as to interfere with the licensee's ability to safely perform the duties within the scope of practice for dentistry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employed or permitted an unlicensed individual to practice dentistry in the office under the dentist's control.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employed or permitted an unlicensed individual to practice dentistry in the office under the dentist's control.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Been grossly negligent in the practice of dentistry.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been grossly negligent in the practice of dentistry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in fraud or deceit in obtaining the license or in the practice of dentistry.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaged in fraud or deceit in obtaining the license or in the practice of dentistry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disclosed confidential information.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Disclosed confidential information.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Shared any professional fee with anyone or paid anyone for sending or referring patients.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Shared any professional fee with anyone or paid anyone for sending or referring patients to the dentist.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Used advertising tending to mislead and deceive the public, including specialty advertising outside scope of qualification.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Used any advertising of any character tending to mislead and deceive the public, including advertising the public could reasonably interpret as indicating the dentist is qualified to practice a dental specialty, if the practice of that dental specialty would be outside the scope of practice for which the dentist is qualified to practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to meet minimum standards of professional competence.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to meet minimum standards of professional competence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribed, administered, or dispensed medications for reasons or conditions outside the scope of dental practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribed, administered, or dispensed medications for reasons or conditions outside the scope of dental practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulently, carelessly, negligently, or inappropriately prescribed drugs or medications.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraudulently, carelessly, negligently, or inappropriately prescribed drugs or medications.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Directed others to perform acts or provide dental services for which they were not licensed or qualified.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Directed others to perform acts or provide dental services for which they were not licensed or qualified or were prohibited by law or rule from performing or providing.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Submitted fraudulent insurance claims.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Submitted fraudulent insurance claims.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Made any false or untrue statements in an application for an examination to obtain a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Made any false or untrue statements in an application for an examination to obtain a license to practice dentistry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Made any false representations that the individual is the holder of a license or certificate of registration.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Made any false representations that the individual is the holder of a license or certificate of registration to practice dentistry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Made any false claims that the individual is a graduate of a dental college or holder of a diploma or degree.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Made any false claims that the individual is a graduate of a dental college or the holder of any diploma or degree from a dental college.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to comply with commonly accepted national infection control guidelines and standards.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to comply with commonly accepted national infection control guidelines and standards.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandoned the dentist's practice in violation of rules adopted by the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abandoned the dentist's practice in violation of rules adopted by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to report to the board as required under section 43-28-18.1.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to report to the board as required under section 43-28-18.1.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to practice within the scope of the dentist's education or advanced training as recognized by the board or ADA.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to practice within the scope of that dentist's education or advanced training as recognized by the board, the American dental association, or other professional entity recognized by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to release copies of dental or medical records requested by a patient of record.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to release copies of dental or medical records requested by a patient of record or violated section 23-12-14.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advised or directed patients to dental laboratories without first furnishing a written prescription.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advised or directed patients to dental laboratories or dental laboratory technicians for any dental service or advised or directed patients to deal directly with laboratories or dental laboratory technicians without first having furnished the dental laboratory or dental laboratory technician a written prescription.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Worked or cooperated with dental laboratories that advertise for public patronage in exchange for referrals.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Worked or cooperated with dental laboratories that advertise for public patronage by delegating work to such laboratories in return for the referral of laboratory patrons for professional services.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Used services of an unlicensed person or entity, or constructed/altered dental appliances outside board rules.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Used the services of a person or entity not licensed to practice dentistry in this state, or constructed, altered, repaired, or duplicated a denture, plate, partial plate, bridge, splint, or orthodontic or prosthetic appliance, except as provided by rule adopted by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated the code of ethics adopted by the board by rule.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated the code of ethics adopted by the board by rule.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated this chapter or rules adopted by the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated this chapter or rules adopted by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Had the applicant's or dentist's license suspended, revoked, or disciplined in another jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Had the applicant's or dentist's license suspended, revoked, or disciplined in another jurisdiction.

definition_quote.value: "Practice of dentistry" means examination, diagnosis, treatment, repair, administration of local or general anesthetics, prescriptions, or surgery of or for any disease, disorder, deficiency, deformity, discoloration, condition, lesion, injury, or pain of the human oral cavity, teeth, gingivae, and soft tissues, and the diagnosis, surgical, and adjunctive treatment of the diseases, injuries, and defects of the upper and lower human jaw and associated structures.

sedation_adverse_event_reporting_require.quote: A mortality or other incident occurring in an outpatient facility of the dentist which results in temporary or permanent physical or mental injury requiring hospitalization of the patient during or as a direct result of a dental procedure or related use of general anesthesia, deep sedation, conscious sedation with a parenteral drug, or enteral sedation.

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: dental hygiene" and the practice thereof means the removal of accumulated matter from the natural and restored surfaces of teeth and from restorations in the human mouth, the polishing of such surfaces, and the topical application of drugs to the surface tissues of the mouth and to the surface of teeth if such acts are performed under the direct, indirect, or general supervision of a licensed dentist.

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: For any person, except a dentist, to own more than forty-nine percent of an office practice or business at which the practice of dentistry is performed.

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: Advised or directed patients to dental laboratories or dental laboratory technicians for any dental service or advised or directed patients to deal directly with laboratories or dental laboratory technicians without first having furnished the dental laboratory or dental laboratory technician a written prescription.

teledentistry_authorized.quote: A dentist is held to the same standard of care and ethical standards, whether practicing traditional in-person dentistry or telehealth.

hygienist_local_anesthesia_certification.quote: A licensed dentist may delegate to a dental hygienist licensed by the board the administration of block and infiltration anesthesia to a patient who is at least eighteen years old. The dental hygienist must be under the direct supervision of a dentist and the dental hygienist must complete the educational requirements as required by the commission on dental accreditation and approved by the board.
